infra.graph.root.label: Entry point
infra.graph.depth.label: Depth
infra.graph.depth.truncated: Reached the {max}-hop depth cap — deeper branches were not built. Expand individual nodes to go further.
infra.graph.traffic.label: Traffic source
infra.graph.traffic.note.xray: Using the X-Ray service graph — metrics per hop.
infra.graph.traffic.note.cloudwatch: No X-Ray: metrics counted from CloudWatch — per-node health, but NO per-edge latency.
infra.graph.traffic.note.none: No traffic source could be read — the graph below is structure only, with no runtime metrics.
infra.graph.notes.title: Notes
infra.graph.note.depthTruncated: Branches are still unbuilt because the depth cap was reached.
infra.graph.note.crossAccount: Some resources live in ANOTHER ACCOUNT — shown as outside-context nodes, and AWOG does not traverse into them.
infra.graph.note.crossRegion: Some resources live in ANOTHER REGION — shown as outside-context nodes, and AWOG does not traverse into them.
infra.graph.note.dnsTargetUnsupported: A DNS record points at a target AWOG cannot map to an AWS service — that branch was not drawn.
infra.graph.note.distributionNotFound: This CloudFront distribution was not found in the pinned account.
infra.graph.note.originNotFound: A cache behavior points at an origin id missing from the distribution's origin list.
infra.graph.note.integrationUnsupported: An API Gateway integration points at a target AWOG cannot map to an AWS service — that branch was not drawn.
infra.graph.note.eventSourceUnsupported: A Lambda event source mapping points at a source AWOG does not support yet — that branch was not drawn.
infra.graph.note.ecsServiceNotFound: This ECS service declares no task definition, so there is nothing to walk into.
infra.graph.note.secretRefOnly: A container references a secret — only the REFERENCE NAME is shown; the value is never read.
infra.graph.note.trafficXray: Using the X-Ray service graph — metrics per hop.
infra.graph.note.trafficCloudwatch: No X-Ray: metrics counted from CloudWatch — per-node health, but NO per-edge latency.
infra.graph.note.trafficNone: No traffic source could be read — the graph is structure only, with no runtime metrics.
infra.graph.note.trafficBlocked: The traffic source could not be read because the call was blocked by the permission gate — the account MAY still have metrics, so this is not a verdict of none.
infra.graph.note.rootsTruncated: The entry-point list was too long and got clipped — some entry points are not shown.
infra.graph.note.noRootFound: No entry point was found in the pinned context.
infra.graph.note.callFailed: Some configuration reads failed — the graph may be missing branches.
infra.graph.note.rootsFailed.route53: Could not list Route53 hosted zones — DNS entry points are missing from this list.
infra.graph.note.rootsFailed.cloudfront: Could not list CloudFront distributions — CDN entry points are missing from this list.
infra.graph.note.rootsFailed.apigateway: Could not list API Gateway — API entry points are missing from this list.
infra.graph.roots.title: Pick an entry point
infra.graph.roots.about: A graph always starts from ONE entry point — a domain, a CloudFront distribution, an API or a CloudFormation stack. There is no draw-the-whole-account button.
infra.graph.roots.empty.title: No entry point yet
infra.graph.roots.empty.body: The pinned context returned no entry point. Check in order: (1) is an AWS profile + region selected in the /infra context bar; (2) does that account have a Route53 hosted zone, CloudFront distribution, API Gateway or CloudFormation stack; (3) does the profile have read access to those services. Then press Reload.
infra.graph.node.noExpand: The resolver has no further step for this node.
infra.graph.panel.externalNote: This node sits outside the pinned account/region — AWOG does not traverse into it.
infra.graph.panel.inferredNote: This relation is inferred from configuration/environment, not from an AWS link that can be listed.
infra.graph.panel.noDetail: The resolver returned no properties for this node.
infra.graph.act.rootsWhy: Read-only: reads configuration to find entry points — nothing is changed.
infra.graph.act.resolveWhy: Read-only: reads configuration (describe-*) to build the graph — nothing is changed.
infra.graph.act.expandWhy: Read-only: reads this node's configuration to walk one hop further — nothing is changed.
infra.graph.error.engine: Cannot reach the engine — check that it is running, then retry.
infra.graph.error.badRoot: This entry point could not be read as an AWS resource — pick a different entry point.
infra.graph.error.callFailed: Every configuration read failed without a specific message — check the profile's read access, then retry.
infra.graph.error.tooManyApprovals: Too many commands still need approval — narrow the entry point, or loosen read commands in Settings → Infrastructure.
infra.graph.trace.banner: Highlighting the path of request {id} — {n} nodes on it.
infra.graph.trace.noMatch: No node on this graph matches the hops we found.
